title: WanyuGroup/NeurIPS2026-NestedVLA
abstract:
[NeurIPS 2026] Core algorithm for NestedVLA: Learning to Consolidate and Generate Skills for Vision-Language-Action Models

# NestedVLA Minimal algorithm release for **NestedVLA: Learning to Consolidate and Generate Skills for Vision-Language-Action Models**. This repository contains the method components needed to: 1. turn action-expert parameter deltas into fixed-size patch tokens; 2. compute a frozen top-(K) support mask and per-patch scales; 3. train a task-conditioned hypernetwork on the tokenized deltas; and 4. generate and reconstruct a task-specific action-expert update. The release intentionally excludes benchmark datasets, robot simulators, training checkpoints, and experiment-specific launch files. ## Install Only PyTorch is required. ## Minimal example The example uses synthetic tensors. In a VLA pipeline, `deltas` are the action-expert differences between independently fine-tuned policies and the frozen base policy. ## Scope This initial release focuses on the core algorithm and a stable tensor-level API. Integration with individual VLA frameworks and released checkpoints will be added separately. ## Citation ## License MIT
abstract_zh: NestedVLA 的核心算法：为视觉-语言-动作模型学习巩固与生成技能。本仓库包含 NestedVLA 方法所需的关键组件：1. 将动作专家参数增量转换为固定大小的 patch token；2. 计算冻结的 top-(K) 支持掩码和每个 patch 的缩放因子；3. 在 token 化后的增量上训练任务条件超网络；4. 生成并重建任务特定的动作专家更新。本次发布有意不包含基准数据集、机器人模拟器、训练检查点和实验特定的启动文件。仅需 PyTorch。示例使用合成张量。在 VLA 流程中，deltas 是独立微调策略与冻结基础策略之间的动作专家差异。本初始版本聚焦核心算法和稳定的张量级 API，与各个 VLA 框架及已发布检查点的集成将另行添加。
tldr_zh: NestedVLA 核心算法：将动作专家参数增量转为 token，用超网络生成任务特定更新。

judge.reason: NeurIPS 2026 官方 VLA 技能整合与生成核心算法，属操作 VLA 方向；但仅发布最小算法、无数据集与仿真器，工程落地性有限。
